description: The hard spending cap of this AgentPay session and what has been spent so far, with the wallets that pay. Pass max_usd to LOWER the cap for this session (or restore it, up to the configured AGENTPAY_MAX_SPEND ceiling); raising the ceiling needs a restart. Call it before the first paid call so the user can confirm or change the cap, and whenever they ask what the agent may spend. Free, local.

max_usd.description: New session cap in USD, at most the configured ceiling and not below what is already spent.

name: session_cap
